description: Golden-scenario band regression fixture (forecast-validation program W2-P5, plan §2.3). Pins an ERCOT reference forecast, 2026-2032, on real HiGHS; check_bands() compares a fresh solve of the same REFERENCE_SCENARIO_KWARGS against the values below.

provenance.notes: confirmed_exits_enabled default-ON as of PR #1434 (commit bc4a3f3, 2026-07-05) is baked into these golden values -- ScenarioConfig.confirmed_exits_enabled defaults True and REFERENCE_SCENARIO_KWARGS does not override it. Never auto-regenerate on a band exit (this is a finding, not a widening target -- see docs/handoffs/forecast-validation-program-2026-07.md §2.3 and CLAUDE.md rule 23's frozen-against-residuals spirit). To regenerate: run `python scripts/golden_forecast_bands.py seed --force --reason "<explicit citation of the causal code change>"` and commit the new tests/golden/ercot_2026_2032*.json alongside that change.
